next_step: Finalize POC results and pricing for Dedicated; legal review kickoff
notes: Account background: mid-market analytics SaaS (B2B) with 450 employees. Heavy use of LLMs in product UX (in-app help, changelog summarization) and backend ranking for documentation search.

Current provider: using "baseline-llm" provider (contracted, paying). Goal is to migrate to Redwood Hosted first to smooth migration, then move to Dedicated (reserved capacity + VPC) in Q2 if POC meets parity and cost targets.

Primary contact (Head of Product): Rajiv Menon — cares about prompt parity and minimizing regressions. Quote from 2026-02-17 call: "We cannot ship with any visible regression in support answers or ranking — our CSAT will drop."
Technical owner (Engineering Lead): Priya Shah — responsible for POC tests and integration. Wants minimal SDK/API changes; asked about a compatibility layer for existing provider endpoints.

Workload details: chat-like support flows (multi-turn), high-cardinality doc search for KB (semantic ranking), nightly batch reranking for release notes. Target latency: p50 <= 150ms for short chat responses; p95 <= 350ms. Throughput: steady-state ~40-60 qps across weekdays, spikes to ~120 qps during product launches.
Cost sensitivity: strong. Current blended spend ~$60k/mo. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching + KV cache) to achieve unit-cost parity or better when on Dedicated.
Model preferences: prefer open-model variants. During demo they liked a Redwood-verified 13B variant for quality/cost tradeoff. Want quantization recommendations for Dedicated.

Migration concerns: tokenization and stop sequence differences causing slightly different outputs; temperature/decoding seed variability leading to ranking regressions. Priya: 'We need a repeatable prompt-test harness.'

POC plan agreed: 3-week POC on Hosted -> compare parity vs baseline provider over shared eval set (2k prompts across support, docs, ranking). Metrics: ranking NDCG@10, answer F1/ROUGE, latency distribution, cost per 1k tokens. Canary will run on Dedicated after parity validated.

POC deliverables: POC report (shared), sample prompts, evaluation harness, regression dashboard, and recommended batch/cache config for Dedicated. Marcus to deliver initial evaluation script by 2026-02-22 (delayed by one week).

Security & compliance: require SSO (SAML), audit logging for model inputs/outputs retention policy (90 days), KMS integration for keys, and EU data residency for subset of logs. Legal asked about DPA language — Redwood legal intro scheduled.

Integration notes: currently using provider's REST endpoint with minor prompt templating. Rajiv asked whether Redwood offers a compatibility wrapper or drop-in path to avoid rewriting endpoints. AE noted Redwood has examples and a small compat shim — Marcus to share sample code.

Demo feedback (2026-02-05): latency looked comparable on p50; streaming differences flagged (client expects chunked tokens). Frontend team flagged need for same streaming semantics to avoid UX rewrite.
Escalations: INF-3421 — token accounting mismatch during initial POC (resolved with patched SDK); SEC-1987 — request for KMS architecture diagram (pending).

Commercials: asked for hosted pricing comparison and committed Dedicated pricing bands for 3/6/12 month terms. Looking for a mid-market anchor ~ $150k ARR. Finance wants a clear migration cost estimate (one-time engineering effort + run-rate delta).

Next steps captured: 1) Redwood to share compatibility shim + streaming examples (Marcus) 2) Finish eval run and share POC report by 2026-03-12 3) Pricing term sheet for Dedicated (Elena) 4) Legal kickoff for DPA/KMS (week of 2026-03-15).

Open blockers reiterated: - Prompt parity/regressions (priority) - Confirm VPC connectivity maintenance window with infra - Finalize dedicated pricing tier and committed throughput - Legal sign-off on data residency clause

Short notes from last touch: 2026-03-08 call — Priya: 'If parity is within 2% of our baseline for NDCG and answer similarity, we can move to Dedicated pilot.' Elena: 'We will prioritize a canary rollout and fallbacks to hosted baseline during first week of Dedicated.'
